summary: Resize the window while honoring Electron minimum-size behavior.

target.notes: Requires an ElectronCompat native-window abstraction so object lifetime and window events remain observable.

caveats: Do not bypass min-size constraints when lowering to toolkit APIs.

tests.name: resize
tests.expected_behavior: window client host is resized according to outer-window semantics

tests.name: below minimum
tests.expected_behavior: resulting size is clamped/snapped to the configured minimum
